MRK.rationale: MRK is extremely unattractive at current levels. The Q1 2026 earnings collapse (EPS -$1.72 vs. +$2.01 YoY) has driven the trailing P/E to 34.6x — the absolute ceiling of its 11.1–35.8x historical range — while the stock has appreciated ~41% over the past year. The 2.9% earnings yield sits well below the 4.54% 10-year Treasury yield, eliminating any margin of safety. Although operating cash flow remains positive ($3.92B, +56.7% YoY) and revenue grew 4.9% YoY, the stock has already priced in a full recovery that is not yet confirmed. The Keytruda patent cliff (late 2028) looms over 46% of revenue, recent Phase 3 misses (EVOKE-03, LITESPARK-012) raise pipeline execution concerns, and Gardasil demand is deteriorating in China/Japan. The trailing valuation offers no cushion if the Q1 2026 charge signals structural impairment rather than a one-time event. All three pillars align negatively: deteriorating earnings trajectory, stretched valuation at historical extremes, and no credible near-term fundamental catalyst to re-rate the stock higher.
key_factors: Q1 2026 EPS collapsed to -$1.72 from +$2.01 YoY and +$2.32 QoQ, driven by a ~$9B surge in operating expenses (likely non-cash charge) that pushed operating income to -$3.53B vs. +$5.90B (Q1 2025)
Trailing P/E diluted of 34.6x on 2026-07-09 is at the absolute ceiling of its 365-day range (11.1x–35.8x), having tripled from 12.2x one year ago (2025-07-10)
Earnings yield of 2.9% falls below the 10-year Treasury yield of 4.54%, implying the market is pricing in significant earnings recovery that is not yet confirmed
Stock price has appreciated ~41% over the past year ($76.66 trough to $125.07) while revenue grew only 4.9% YoY — price has moved ahead of fundamental improvement
Keytruda patent cliff (late 2028) threatens 46% of revenue ($29.5B in 2024); FY2026 consensus revenue growth is only 1.4%
Recent Phase 3 pipeline misses: EVOKE-03 trial discontinued (TROP2 ADC) and LITESPARK-012 missed primary endpoints, raising execution risk on post-Keytruda diversification
Gardasil demand deteriorating in China and Japan; China partner paused shipments amid regulatory/inventory disputes
Operating cash flow of $3.92B in Q1 2026 (+56.7% YoY) and revenue of $16.29B (+4.9% YoY) confirm underlying business is intact, but this is already priced in at current valuation
Total equity declined from $51.91B (Q3 2025) to $45.93B (Q1 2026); ROE compressed from 36.7% to 19.5%
CMS proposed Medicare drug price negotiations beginning 2029 add regulatory uncertainty to post-Keytruda pricing
